subject: System Design
title: Defense in Depth
description: A short lesson to help you apply Defense in Depth.

hook.text: Every major failure has one thing in common: multiple safety layers failed at the same time.

buildup.text: Defense in depth means layering protections so no single failure can cause a catastrophe.

discovery.text: The Swiss Cheese Model shows that holes in each layer must align for an incident to occur.

twist.text: Adding more layers helps, but each layer must be independently maintained. Correlated failures bypass them all.

climax.text: Equifax had monitoring, but its certificate expired. GitLab had five backups, but none were tested.

punchline.text: Layer your defenses and verify each one independently.

quiz.question: What does the Swiss Cheese Model illustrate?
options: Failures happen when holes in multiple safety layers align
